messages:
asha: Heads-up — saw a spike in token-level p50/p99 for /api/generate around 03:20 UTC yesterday. Correlates with increased kvcache evictions and a jump in generic-kernel fallbacks.
marc: Thanks, any quick dashboard links or traces?
asha: Putting the quick trace here — looks like a drop in prefix_reuse_rate from ~0.72 -> 0.18, evictions up, memory per-prefix unchanged.
jin: Did we change prefix sampling or retention recently? even small sampling changes can hide reuse and make us evict more aggressively.
asha: We rolled prefix_sample_rate 0.1 -> 0.02 in PR #2321 to reduce telemetry cost. That reduced telemetry but maybe removed enough signal to change our eviction heuristics.
ravi: That could explain more cold KV loads, which in turn changes batch composition. When KV misses are common batches have higher variance in seq lengths -> kernel selector picks fallback path more often.
marc: Can we get a compact set of panels to prove causality? I want: per-route prefix_reuse_rate, evictions/sec by route, eviction_age_histogram, kv_memory_top10_prefixes, kernel_choice_by_seq_len, and token_latency_breakdown_by_route (token decode / kv-lookup / kernel-exec).
asha: +1. Sample PromQL for reuse rate I used:```sum by(route) (increase(kv_cache_hits_total{env=\"prod\"}[15m])) / sum by(route) (increase(kv_cache_lookups_total{env=\"prod\"}[15m]))```
jin: Nice. For evictions:```sum by(route) (increase(kv_cache_evictions_total{env=\"prod\"}[15m]))```
jin: For eviction age histogram we need the bucketed histogram we started emitting last month: kv_eviction_age_seconds_bucket.
marc: Also we should tag kernel_choice in traces. Asha, can you add a short trace snippet showing kernel=generic vs kernel=optimized and kv_hit=true/false? That will make the path visible in Jaeger.
asha: Yep, attached a short example span (redacted). In the noisy period nearly all p99 traces show kernel=generic + kv_hit=false in the early tokens.
ravi: Proposal: temporarily bump prefix_sample_rate to 0.08 for a canary (10% traffic) and turn on verbose telemetry for 1 hour to capture kernel selection + kv_hit flags. Then compare delay in token latencies and eviction counts.
marc: Sounds good. Also add a small panel that splits kernel_choice counts by route and by model_version — I've seen kernel selector choose suboptimal kernels when sequence length distribution per-route shifts after UI changes.
jin: Small instrumentation asks:
- Emit kv_hit boolean tag on token-level spans (already done in a few places but not everywhere).
- Emit kernel_selector_reason label (seq_len_bucket, mem_pressure, fallback) on span or metric.
- Add route tag to kernel selection metric.
These are low-risk and let dashboards answer causality.
asha: I'll open a perf-telemetry PR. Action list:
- marc: create Grafana dashboard with the 6 panels + one that overlays sample_rate changes (ETA: today EOD).
- jin: add kernel_choice metrics/tags to tracing (ETA: tomorrow morning).
- ravi: run canary with sample_rate=0.08 on 10% for 1h and collect verbose traces (ETA: tomorrow 09:00 UTC).
- asha: collect and paste representative p99 spans + export to /tmp for postmortem (ETA: after canary).
perf-bot: perf alert suppressed for 30m while triage in progress. :white_check_mark:
marc: Thanks — once the canary runs we can compare: prefix_reuse, evictions, per-token latency (kv-lookup vs kernel-exec), and kernel_choice distribution. If reuse recovers and p99 falls, we revert sample_rate change or tune eviction heuristics.
jin: One more thought — add a metric for avg_prefix_size_in_kb and top10-prefetch-bytes to see if a few large prefixes cause eviction cascades.
ravi: Agreed. Also we should capture per-route batch_size_distribution to see how KV misses affect batching heuristics.
asha: ok will add those to the dashboard request. Thanks team. :pray:
marc: I'll spin up the initial dashboard and post a link here when ready.
asha: great — will follow up with traces after canary.
marc: ack, assigned. :thumbsup:
